entities.name: Sidelink DRX Assistance Information Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for a UE to inform its peer UE of sidelink DRX assistance information used to determine sidelink DRX configuration for unicast communication.

entities.name: UEAssistanceInformationSidelink
entities.description: Message transmitted from UE to peer UE containing sidelink DRX assistance information.

entities.name: Sidelink DRX Assistance Information
entities.description: Information element containing desired sidelink DRX configuration for unicast communication.

entities.name: Sidelink Unicast Communication
entities.description: Condition where UE is engaged in sidelink unicast communication with peer UE.

entities.name: UE Determines DRX Configuration
entities.description: UE implementation determines its desired sidelink DRX configuration for unicast communication.

relations.description: The procedure involves sending UEAssistanceInformationSidelink message.
The message contains sidelink DRX assistance information.
The procedure is used for sidelink unicast communication.
When in sidelink unicast communication, UE implementation determines desired DRX configuration.
